environment.description: CLI tool deployed on a Kubernetes pod running as a task scheduler. The RSA public key is available at /etc/service/keys/auth_public.pem (mounted from a ConfigMap). The PyJWT library version is 2.6.0. SECRET_SEED is set via a Kubernetes Secret. The pod accepts JWT tokens from external callers via a sidecar proxy that passes tokens as CLI arguments. No algorithm restriction is enforced at the infrastructure level.
